entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Sarah with VeloFit Customer Support. How can I help you today?
I need to return a VeloBand Cadence Sensor. I just need the shipping label.

I can certainly help you with that. To get started, can I have your order number? And just so I can document this correctly, what specifically is the issue with the band? Is it a technical fault or a preference?
Order number is VF-8675309. It's a technical fault. The device is not working at all. It just seems completely broken.
I'm sorry to hear that. When you say it's not working, can you be more specific? For example, does it not power on, or is there an issue with connectivity?
It powers on, but it won't sync with my phone app or my bike computer. I've tried resetting it a dozen times. It's defective. I don't have time to troubleshoot, I just want to return it.
I understand your frustration. Thank you for that information. Let me pull up your order... Okay, I see it was delivered 18 days ago. One moment while I review our return eligibility.
Look, is this going to be a problem? It's a defective product. Just tell me yes or no.
Not a problem at all, sir. I've just confirmed our policy. Your item is well within our 90-day return window. I can process this for you right now.

Absolutely. I have initiated the return. You will receive an email with a pre-paid shipping label in the next few minutes. Just attach that to the original packaging and drop it off with the carrier. Once we receive the defective band, a full refund will be issued to your original form of payment.
I'm glad I could resolve this for you quickly. Is there anything else I can assist with today?
Thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a great day.
